# Aashvo (https://aashvo.vercel.app)
> Find your place. Find your people.

Aashvo is a verified pan-India shared-living and flatmate discovery platform designed for university students, young professionals, and relocating individuals. The platform eliminates broker fees and provides itemized cost transparency and rental agreement trust.

## Core Marketplace Categories
- **Flatmates & Shared Living**: Connect with compatible roommates based on verified lifestyle habits (food habits, sleep schedules, cleanliness levels, and shared interests) with adult eligibility verification (age 18+).
- **Family Stays (with Homecooked Meals)**: Private rooms inside family homes where the host family lives on the property, providing safe environments with transparent meal inclusions (included, optional extra, or none).
- **Direct-Owner Flats & Rooms**: Zero-brokerage apartments and builder floors with transparent monthly rent, security deposit limits, and maintenance costs.

## Operating Metros & Cities (India)
- Delhi NCR (Gurugram, Noida, South Delhi, Dwarka, Cyber City, Golf Course Road, Sector 62)
- Bengaluru (Koramangala, HSR Layout, Indiranagar, Whitefield, Electronic City)
- Mumbai & Navi Mumbai (Bandra, Andheri, Powai, Thane)
- Pune (Kothrud, Viman Nagar, Hinjewadi, Baner)
- Hyderabad (HITEC City, Gachibowli, Madhapur, Kondapur)

## Key Value Propositions & Safety Guarantees
- **Zero Brokerage Fees**: Direct connection between renters, flatmates, and homeowners.
- **Location Privacy Masking**: Precise residential street addresses and unit numbers are masked publicly to prevent unwanted walk-ins, revealing exact locations only after mutual inquiry acceptance.
- **Contact Privacy**: Phone numbers remain masked (+91 ***** *XXXX) until an inquiry is accepted.
- **Tenancy Trust Protection**: Digital tenancy agreement drafting, itemized move-in condition reports, and deposit dispute resolution frameworks.

## Technical & Architectural Overview
- **Production Website**: https://aashvo.vercel.app
- **Official Contact**: support@aashvo.com | support@aashvo.in
- **Repository**: https://github.com/Ar10Ansari/aashvo
- **Architecture**: Modular monolith NestJS 11 backend, PostgreSQL 16 database, Prisma ORM, and React 18 TypeScript frontend.
